g.text: Binomial statistics, assuming independent tests drawn from the operational distribution. (a) Smallest n with P(at most k failures | n, p) ≤ 1 − confidence. (b)
One-sided Clopper–Pearson 95 % upper bound. For no failures, n ≈ 3/p at 95 % (the 'rule of three').
